name: monaco-editor
what: The complete published Monaco source distribution (esm/ + dev/ AMD + min/ + monaco.d.ts + licenses). This is VSCode's editor, exactly as microsoft/vscode publishes it under the monaco-editor package.

integrity_self.method: sha256 over sorted "relpath\0size\0sha256(content)\n" for every file

immutability: This tree is vendored whole. No package manager ever touches it: nothing here is installed, hoisted, deduped or rewritten by npm, pnpm, yarn or any other tool. `python3 tools/csgraph/vendor_monaco.py --verify` recomputes the tree hash above and fails if a single byte moved.
runtime_dependencies: none. marked and dompurify, which the esm/ build lists as dependencies, are inlined into the min/ bundle (verified by inspecting min/vs chunks); min/ is fully self-contained.
